records.title: Zinnia elegans (Zinnia)
records.institution: North Carolina State University Extension Gardener

evidence.excerpt: Deer do not find this plant appetizing. The Profusion Series features a cross between Zinnia angustifolia and Zinnia elegans , combining the best of each. It has superior disease resistance and drought resistance. It is tolerant of heat and humidity. New flowers grow above the old flowers; therefore, no deadheading is required.
